Changes the text of an entry.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
win  = CreateWindow("Modify", 10, 10, 300, 200, Desktop(), 3)
list = CreateListBox(10, 10, 200, 100, win)
AddGadgetItem list, "Old name"
ModifyGadgetItem list, 0, "New name"
Repeat
Until WaitEvent() = $803
```
@param gadget  Handle of a list box, combo box or tabber.
@param index   Number of the entry, starting at 0.
@param text    The new text.
@param icon    Number of an icon of the gadget. Defaults to -1, which means none.
